narration: Open enrollment is happening right now — and there's a $5,000 benefit hiding in your packet that 60% of parents completely skip. Here's the one you can't afford to miss.
visual: Parent and child silhouettes holding hands, green glow behind them. Large $5,000 TAX-FREE badge springs in at the bottom. Headline: OPEN ENROLLMENT IS HAPPENING RIGHT NOW.

narration: It's called a Dependent Care FSA — a tax-free account your employer offers to cover childcare costs. You contribute pre-tax, which means the government never touches that money.
visual: Animated folder opening to reveal three stacked dollar bills totaling $5,000. Text overlay: DEPENDENT CARE FSA — PRE-TAX MONEY THE GOVERNMENT NEVER TAKES A CUT.

narration: And here's the wild part — it covers way more than just daycare. After-school programs, summer day camps, preschool. Any care for a child under thirteen while you work.
visual: Three icons spring in one by one: a house (daycare), school building (after-school), smiling sun (summer camp). Each has a green checkmark. ANY CHILD UNDER 13 WHILE YOU WORK.

narration: Put in $5,000 and you're saving $1,100 to $2,250 in real taxes — depending on your bracket. That's money your government would've taken that now pays for your kid's afterschool instead.
visual: Three growing bar chart columns: 22% bracket ($1,100 saved), 24% bracket ($1,600 saved), 32% bracket ($2,250 saved). Each bar springs up with dollar amounts above. Bottom: IN REAL TAX SAVINGS EVERY YEAR.

narration: So why do 60% of eligible parents skip it? They don't know it exists — and open enrollment closes December 31st. Miss that deadline and you wait an entire year to sign up again.
visual: December calendar with Dec 31 circled in red and an X through it. Animated clock sweeping. '60% SKIP IT' badge pops in. DEADLINE: DEC 31.

narration: Go to your benefits portal right now — search for Dependent Care FSA and click enroll. Five minutes today could put $2,000 back in your pocket this year. Don't be in the 60%.
